Directed by Roderick MacKay and stars Ahmed Malick, Baykali Ganambarr and David Wenham.

programme.title: Delfin

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. After learning about Italy’s oldest ewe’s milk cheese, which is matured in a terracotta jar, Will gets a lesson from a Countess in how to make the perfect wood-fired pizza. He then heads to the coast to look at cacao Cavallo, a traditional stretched curd cheese made with cow’s milk, before visiting the underground maturation rooms of Casa Madaio where the finest examples are aged.

He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

Directed by Roderick MacKay and stars Ahmed Malick, Baykali Ganambarr and David Wenham.

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. Nominated for three Academy Awards in 2002, and Winner of Best Supporting Actor (Jim Broadbent). Directed by Richard Eyre and also stars Judi Dench and Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.sub-title: Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania
programme.desc: Will journeys to Italy’s picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk. After learning about Italy’s oldest ewe’s milk cheese, which is matured in a terracotta jar, Will gets a lesson from a Countess in how to make the perfect wood-fired pizza. He then heads to the coast to look at cacao Cavallo, a traditional stretched curd cheese made with cow’s milk, before visiting the underground maturation rooms of Casa Madaio where the finest examples are aged.

It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.title: Italian Food Safari
programme.desc: Tonight, Guy visits dedicated Melbourne artisan baker Daniel Chirico and tastes bread straight from the oven. Guy then demonstrates a delicious bread-based salad called panzanella. Maeve learns about the Italian passion for veal and meets passionate Western Australian butcher Vince Garreffa. And celebrated Sydney chef Nino Zoccali shows how easy it is to make a beautiful osso buco.

programme.title: America The Bountiful
programme.desc: Pears got their start in Oregon back in 1847 when an Iowa native brought the fruit to the region. In 2005, the Oregon legislature named the pear the state fruit.

programme.title: Nadiya's American Adventure
programme.desc: Nadiya Hussain has always been fascinated by America, home to more immigrants than any other country, and with some of the most vibrant food on the planet.

programme.title: This Tastes Funny

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson treats her supper guests to a sumptuous feast of lamb chops with mint, chilli and golden potatoes, served alongside roasted red onions with fennel and basil. Dessert is a true Anglo-Italian affair with a ruby red plum and amaretto crumble. There is also Nigella's easy no-stir farro risotto with mushrooms, and chocolate pasta with a dark butterscotch sauce - a perfect supper for those nights when you can't decide if you're in the mood for savoury or sweet.

programme.title: Nadiya's Spices Made Simple
programme.desc: Nadiya's uses her eight heroic spices to rustle up a chicken curry, deep-fried samosa, tangy tomato prawn dish, and lastly her son's favourite cake, a soft vanilla and lemon sponge.

programme.title: Jamie's American Road Trip
programme.desc: With no experience in backpacking, Jamie finds himself in unknown territory during the harsh Arizona winter. He leaves the tourist trail to spend time with the Navajo Indians on the largest reservation in America. Staying with Mayor Elect Roy Kady, who also happens to be a sheep farmer, Jamie witnesses Navajo traditions up close - from butchery, to overnighting in a hogan, and cooking with elders. He also gets a crash course in Navajo spirituality.

programme.title: River Cottage Vegetables
programme.desc: Hugh goes fishing and has to pass up fresh sushi. Hugh also prepares a full cricket tea without a pork pie in sight.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road To Mexico

programme.sub-title: Rainbow Warrior: Murder In The Pacific Series 1 Ep 3
programme.desc: In the final part of the story, we hear from the bomber himself how he came to plant the bombs on the Greenpeace ship Rainbow Warrior and the measures he took to escape New Zealand after the attack. He and another suspect reveal the origins of the mission: the French government convincing them that the KGB had infiltrated Greenpeace, and we learn that the agents' reasons for their military service are not so far removed from the motivations of the Greenpeace activists.

programme.desc: In this quartet of neo-noir tales, a mysterious salesman narrates a tragic story of co-dependency, while a musclebound vigilante tears his way through the criminal underworld in search of his lost love. In another part of the city, a grizzled cop foils the ambitions of a child-killer, and an ex-prostitute evades her ex-pimp with the help of her new boyfriend, Dwight. Stars Josh Hartnett, Mickey Rourke, Jessica Alba, Jaime King, Bruce Willis, Benicio Del Toro, Brittany Murphy and Clive Owe.

programme.desc: Set in the Western Australian outback during the gold rushes of the 1890s. To escape a harsh existence and return to his home country, a young Afghan cameleer falls in with a mysterious bushman on the run with stolen Crown gold. Directed by Roderick MacKay and stars Ahmed Malick, Baykali Ganambarr and David Wenham.

programme.title: The Movie Show

programme.title: A Room With A View
programme.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programme.title: Delfin
programme.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin (Valentino Catania), an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small dusty town on the outskirts of a Buenos Aires. Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. Nominated for three Academy Awards in 2002, and Winner of Best Supporting Actor (Jim Broadbent). Directed by Richard Eyre and also stars Judi Dench and Kate Winslet.

programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

programme.title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
programme.desc: Wallace Ritchie, an American vacationer in London, thinks the bullets, truth serum and intrigue erupting around him is part of an audience-participation theatre event. Yet the world's fate depends on this gullible dummy who can't even spell CIA.

programme.title: The Big Lebowski
programme.desc: A cult classic where 'The Dude' (Jeff Bridges) is mistaken for a millionaire, dragging him and his friends into crime and chaos. A hilarious, unforgettable Coen Brothers comedy.

programme.desc: A young American journalist stranded in present-day Nicaragua falls for an enigmatic Englishman who seems like her best chance of escape. She soon realises that he may be in even greater danger.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.sub-title: Mozzarella And The Cheeses Of Campania
programme.desc: Will journeys to Italy’s picturesque Campania region to look at stretched curd cheeses and finds it hard to resist the lingering flavour and sensual texture of buffalo cheese made from raw milk. After learning about Italy’s oldest ewe’s milk cheese, which is matured in a terracotta jar, Will gets a lesson from a Countess in how to make the perfect wood-fired pizza. He then heads to the coast to look at cacao Cavallo, a traditional stretched curd cheese made with cow’s milk, before visiting the underground maturation rooms of Casa Madaio where the finest examples are aged.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Gustavo & Carissa's dream kitchen has become a nightmare. With baby gear everywhere, poor storage & broken appliances, cooking is chaos. Can Ellen transform their dysfunctional space into a safe, warm & functional kitchen for their growing family?

programme.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programme.desc: Western Australia’s wheat-belt is abundant with ancient crops, and on this journey from the outskirts of Perth to Narembeen, Adam meets many hardworking farmers who have based their livelihoods on unusual ingredients. It’s grape-picking season in the Swan Valley and, while visiting a couple whose Croatian ancestors have been growing table grapes for centuries, Adam whips up a grape and rosemary focaccia. He next meets a wheat-turned-quinoa farmer and learns of the challenges of making the South American crop work. After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

At the Dapto Community Garden, they collect kohlrabi with Harry, and over in Gerringong they stumble upon a coffee plantation on a picturesque hill. They retire for a game of cricket at the Bradman Museum in Bowral and learn about the rich Indigenous sporting history of the sport in Australia.

As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. programme.title: Gosford Park
programme.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely produced and shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.

After meeting a farmer running an Egyptian breed of sheep, Adam creates a Middle Eastern lamb masterpiece.

As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Directed by Roderick MacKay and stars Ahmed Malick, Baykali Ganambarr and David Wenham.

Here he must support his father (Cristian Salguero) by working as a delivery boy before school. Above all though, Delfin wants to audition to play the French Horn in a children's orchestra that is being formed in a neighbouring village.

Nominated for three Academy Awards in 2002, and Winner of Best Supporting Actor (Jim Broadbent). Directed by Richard Eyre and also stars Judi Dench and Kate Winslet.

The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house, Sir William McCordle (Michael Gambon). Getting on in years, William has become a benefactor to many of his relatives and friends. As the weekend goes on, secrets are revealed, and it seems that everyone, above stairs and below, wants a piece of William and his money.

Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief’s scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community and must speak up to defend the ones he loves. Stars Fa'afiaula Sanote and Tausili Pushparaj.
